name: Image Utility
description: Free, 100% private client-side in-browser image editing tools with zero server uploads.

tools.name: resize
tools.description: Resize image width and height dimensions with aspect ratio lock.

tools.name: compress
tools.description: Compress image to target KB or quality slider.

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Convert image between PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, BMP, and ICO.

tools.name: crop
tools.description: Crop rectangular image regions with freeform or fixed aspect ratios.

tools.name: circle
tools.description: Circle crop image to create rounded profile pictures with transparent PNG.

tools.name: radius
tools.description: Round image corners with transparent outer clipping.

tools.name: border
tools.description: Add customizable border frame and padding to image.

tools.name: adjust
tools.description: Fine-tune exposure, contrast, saturation, warmth, and 9 creative filters.

tools.name: rotate
tools.description: Rotate 90, 180, 270 degrees or mirror flip horizontally/vertically.

tools.name: favicon
tools.description: Generate multi-resolution .ico favicons, Apple Touch icons, and PWA icons.

tools.name: watermark
tools.description: Add customizable text watermarks with opacity and positioning.

tools.name: pdf
tools.description: Convert single images to A4, Letter, or fit printable PDFs.

tools.name: metadata
tools.description: Scrub EXIF tags, GPS location coordinates, and camera serial metadata.
